zh: 会议几点开始？
en: What time does the meeting start?
alt: When's the meeting?
point: 一般疑问要加 does，不说 What time the meeting start

zh: 你今天不是休假吗？
en: Aren't you off today?
alt: Weren't you supposed to be on leave today?
point: “你不是…吗”用否定疑问 Aren't you…?；休假说 off

zh: 你清过缓存没有？
en: Have you cleared your cache?
alt: Did you clear the cache?
point: “…过没有”用 Have you done…?；清缓存是 clear the cache

zh: 这个密码是谁改的？
en: Who changed this password?
alt: Who's changed the password?
point: 问主语用 Who + 动词，不要加 did

zh: 你们几点关门？
en: What time do you close?
alt: When do you close?
point: 问店家用 do you，不说 What time you close

zh: 这个辣不辣？
en: Is this one spicy?
alt: Is it hot?
point: “辣不辣”是一般疑问 Is it…?，不说 spicy or not spicy

zh: 昨天谁赢了？
en: Who won yesterday?
alt: Who won the game yesterday?
point: 问主语直接 Who won，不说 Who did win

zh: 你多久去一次健身房？
en: How often do you go to the gym?
alt: How many times a week do you go to the gym?
point: “多久一次”是 How often，不是 How long

zh: 这双鞋多少钱？
en: How much are these shoes?
alt: How much do these shoes cost?
point: 鞋是复数，用 How much are these…

zh: 请问试衣间在哪儿？
en: Where are the changing rooms?
alt: Excuse me, where can I try this on?
point: 试衣间英式说 changing rooms，复数用 are

zh: 去机场要多久？
en: How long does it take to get to the airport?
alt: How long's it take to the airport?
point: “要多久”用 How long does it take，别漏 it

zh: 这趟车到不到Britomart？
en: Does this bus go to Britomart?
alt: Is this the bus for Britomart?
point: “到不到”用 Does this bus go to…?，不说 arrive or not

zh: 你怎么了？哪里不舒服？
en: What's wrong? Are you not feeling well?
alt: What's the matter? Are you feeling unwell?
point: “怎么了”说 What's wrong，不说 How are you

zh: 你吃药了吗？
en: Have you taken your medicine?
alt: Did you take your pills?
point: 吃药用 take，不是 eat

zh: 钥匙你放哪儿了？
en: Where did you put the keys?
alt: Where have you put the keys?
point: “放哪儿了”用 Where did you put…，put 过去式不变

zh: 你还没睡啊？
en: Are you still up?
alt: Haven't you gone to bed yet?
point: “还没睡”说 still up，不说 still not sleep

zh: 你是哪里人？
en: Where are you from?
alt: Where are you originally from?
point: “哪里人”说 Where are you from，介词 from 放句末

zh: 今天天气真好，是吧？
en: Lovely day, isn't it?
alt: It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
point: “是吧”用反义疑问 isn't it?，不说 yes?

zh: 这个月房租你交了吗？
en: Have you paid this month's rent?
alt: Did you pay the rent this month?
point: “交了吗”用现在完成 Have you paid…?

zh: 我欠你多少钱？
en: How much do I owe you?
alt: What do I owe you?
point: “欠你多少”说 How much do I owe you，别漏 do

zh: 你知道Sarah今天在不在办公室吗？
en: Do you know if Sarah's in the office today?
alt: Do you know whether Sarah's in today?
point: 间接疑问用 if + 陈述语序，不说 if is Sarah

zh: 这个报告周五之前能做完吗？客户在催了。
en: Will the report be done by Friday? The client's chasing us.
alt: Can we get the report finished by Friday? The client keeps asking.
point: “做完”说 be done by；“催”说 chase

zh: 你知道这个报错是什么意思吗？我搜了半天也没搞懂。
en: Do you know what this error means? I've been googling it for ages.
alt: Any idea what this error means? I've searched everywhere and still can't work it out.
point: 间接疑问 what this error means，不说 what does it mean

zh: 你没把改动推上去吗？我这边还是看不到。
en: Didn't you push your changes? I still can't see them on my end.
alt: Haven't you pushed the changes yet? They're not showing up for me.
point: “你没…吗”用否定疑问 Didn't you…?

zh: 这道菜要等多久？我们一个小时后还有事。
en: How long will this dish take? We've got to be somewhere in an hour.
alt: How long's the wait for this? We need to leave in an hour.
point: 等多久说 How long will it take；“有事”说 be somewhere

zh: 你们是一起付还是分开付？分开的话我可以帮你们拆单。
en: Are you paying together or separately? I can split the bill if you like.
alt: Is this all on one bill, or are you splitting it?
point: 选择疑问 A or B?；分开付说 split the bill

zh: 你觉得这个赛季哪个队最有可能夺冠？
en: Which team do you reckon is most likely to win this season?
alt: Who do you think will win the title this season?
point: 插入 do you reckon 后用陈述语序；reckon 是 Kiwi 常用的 think

zh: 你不是说膝盖受伤了吗？怎么还去踢球？
en: Didn't you say you'd hurt your knee? Why are you still playing football?
alt: I thought you'd injured your knee. How come you're still playing?
point: “你不是说…吗”用 Didn't you say…?；“怎么还”用 Why / How come

zh: 请问洗手液在哪个货架？我找了一圈没找到。
en: Excuse me, which aisle is the hand soap in? I've looked everywhere.
alt: Sorry, where can I find the hand soap? I can't seem to find it.
point: 超市货架说 aisle；介词 in 放句末

zh: 这个能退吗？我昨天买的，还没拆。
en: Can I return this? I bought it yesterday and haven't opened it.
alt: Is it possible to get a refund? I only bought it yesterday and it's still unopened.
point: “能退吗”说 Can I return this，不说 Can this return

zh: 你知道最后一班渡轮几点开吗？
en: Do you know what time the last ferry leaves?
alt: Any idea when the last ferry goes?
point: 间接疑问 what time the last ferry leaves，不加 does

zh: 我们到底什么时候能登机？已经延误两个小时了。
en: When are we actually going to board? It's already been delayed two hours.
alt: When do we get to board? We've been delayed two hours already.
point: “到底”用 actually；延误了多久用完成时

zh: 你最近睡得怎么样？是不是压力太大了？
en: How have you been sleeping lately? Are you under a lot of stress?
alt: How's your sleep been? Is work stressing you out?
point: “最近…怎么样”用 How have you been + -ing

zh: 医生下一次什么时候有空？我需要复查一下。
en: When's the doctor next available? I need a follow-up appointment.
alt: When can I next see the doctor? I need to come back for a check-up.
point: “什么时候有空”说 When's … available；复查是 follow-up

zh: 谁又把脏碗留在水槽里了？说好了要轮流洗的。
en: Who left the dirty dishes in the sink again? We agreed to take turns.
alt: Who's left their dishes in the sink again? I thought we were taking turns.
point: 问主语 Who left…，不加 did；轮流说 take turns

zh: 暖气是不是坏了？屋里怎么这么冷。
en: Is the heater broken? Why is it so cold in here?
alt: Has the heat pump stopped working? It's freezing in here.
point: “怎么这么冷”用 Why is it so cold，主语用 it

zh: 你还记得我们上次是在哪儿见的吗？我一下子想不起来了。
en: Do you remember where we met last time? It's completely slipped my mind.
alt: Can you remember where we last caught up? I can't think of it.
point: 间接疑问 where we met，不说 where did we meet

zh: 你周末过得怎么样？有没有去哪儿玩？
en: How was your weekend? Did you get up to anything fun?
alt: Did you have a good weekend? Go anywhere nice?
point: “去哪儿玩”口语说 get up to anything，不说 go where play

zh: 你知道现在房贷利率大概是多少吗？我想重新固定一下。
en: Do you know what mortgage rates are at the moment? I'm looking to refix.
alt: Any idea what interest rates are like right now? My mortgage is coming up for refixing.
point: 间接疑问 what rates are，不说 what are rates

zh: 你上个月是不是多扣了我一次钱？账单上有两笔一样的。
en: Did you charge me twice last month? There are two identical payments on my statement.
alt: Have I been charged twice? My statement shows the same amount two times.
point: “多扣一次钱”说 charge me twice；账单是 statement

zh: 我想问一下，下周的培训是我们组都要参加，还是只需要新人去？
en: I was wondering if the whole team needs to go to next week's training, or just the new starters?
alt: Could you let me know whether everyone on the team has to attend the training next week, or only the new people?
point: 委婉提问用 I was wondering if + 陈述语序

zh: 我们不是上周就定好用这个方案了吗？为什么现在又要改？
en: Didn't we agree on this approach last week? Why are we changing it now?
alt: I thought we'd signed off on this plan last week. How come we're changing it again?
point: 否定疑问 Didn't we…? 表示惊讶；“定好”说 agree on / sign off

zh: 你能查一下为什么部署老是失败吗？我看了日志也没看出什么问题。
en: Could you look into why the deployment keeps failing? I've been through the logs and can't see anything wrong.
alt: Can you check why the deploy keeps falling over? The logs don't show anything obvious.
point: 间接疑问 why … keeps failing 不倒装；“老是”用 keep + -ing

zh: 这个bug只在生产环境出现，还是测试环境也能复现？
en: Does this bug only show up in production, or can you reproduce it in the test environment as well?
alt: Is this a prod-only bug, or can it be reproduced in test too?
point: 选择疑问两半都用疑问语序；复现是 reproduce

zh: 不好意思，我们点的菜是不是被忘了？已经等了快四十分钟了。
en: Sorry, has our order been forgotten? We've been waiting for nearly forty minutes for our mains.
alt: Excuse me, do you know what's happening with our mains? It's been almost forty minutes.
point: 被动疑问 Has … been forgotten?；等了多久用完成进行时

zh: 你知道这家店要不要提前订位吗？周五晚上一般人很多。
en: Do you know if we need to book this place in advance? It's usually packed on Friday nights.
alt: Do you know whether we have to make a reservation? It's normally really busy on a Friday night.
point: 间接疑问 if we need to…；订位说 book

zh: 你看昨晚的比赛了吗？最后那个达阵简直不可思议，对吧？
en: Did you watch the game last night? That last try was unbelievable, wasn't it?
alt: Did you catch the match last night? The try at the end was incredible, eh?
point: 反义疑问 was…, wasn't it?；达阵是 try，Kiwi 也说 eh

zh: 你知道下赛季报名什么时候截止吗？我可不想再错过了。
en: Do you know when the registration deadline is for next season? I don't want to miss it again.
alt: When do sign-ups close for next season, do you know? I don't want to miss out again.
point: 间接疑问里 is 放后面：when the deadline is

zh: 这台吸尘器和那台有什么区别？价格差了快两百块。
en: What's the difference between this vacuum and that one? There's almost two hundred dollars between them.
alt: How's this vacuum different from that one? One's nearly $200 more.
point: “有什么区别”说 What's the difference between A and B

zh: 你们不是有价格匹配吗？同一款在Noel Leeming便宜五十块。
en: Don't you guys do price matching? The exact same model is fifty dollars cheaper at Noel Leeming.
alt: I thought you offered price matching? Noel Leeming has the same one for $50 less.
point: 否定疑问 Don't you…? 表示“不是…吗”

zh: 你能告诉我从这儿怎么去Hobbiton吗？我们没租车。
en: Could you tell me how we can get to Hobbiton from here? We haven't hired a car.
alt: What's the best way to get to Hobbiton from here without a car?
point: Could you tell me how we can… 用陈述语序；租车说 hire a car

zh: 我们的行李是直接转到奥克兰，还是要在悉尼取了再重新托运？
en: Will our bags go straight through to Auckland, or do we have to collect them in Sydney and check them in again?
alt: Are our bags checked through to Auckland, or do we need to pick them up in Sydney and recheck them?
point: 选择疑问两半都用疑问语序；托运是 check in

zh: 你不觉得你最近加班太多了吗？身体要紧，别硬撑。
en: Don't you think you've been doing too much overtime lately? Your health comes first, so don't push yourself too hard.
alt: Aren't you working way too much overtime these days? Look after yourself and don't overdo it.
point: “你不觉得…吗”用 Don't you think…?

zh: 我想知道这个检查需不需要空腹，还有大概多久能出结果。
en: I'd like to know whether I need to fast before the test, and roughly how long the results will take.
alt: Can you tell me if I have to fast beforehand, and when I'll get the results?
point: 间接疑问 whether I need to… / how long … will take，不倒装

zh: 你能问问房东，热水到底什么时候来修吗？都坏了一个星期了。
en: Could you ask the landlord when exactly they're coming to fix the hot water? It's been broken for a week.
alt: Can you check with the landlord when someone's going to sort out the hot water? It's been out for a week now.
point: 间接疑问 when they're coming，不说 when are they coming

zh: 家里的网是不是又出问题了，还是只有我这样？我刚才开视频会议断了好几次。
en: Is the Wi-Fi playing up again, or is it just me? My video call kept dropping out just now.
alt: Is the internet slow again or is it only me? My video call cut out a few times.
point: …, or is it just me? 很常用；网络出毛病 Kiwi 说 playing up

zh: 你应该认识Tom吧？他以前好像跟你在同一家公司。
en: You know Tom, don't you? I think he used to work at the same company as you.
alt: You've met Tom, haven't you? I'm pretty sure he used to work with you.
point: “…吧？”用反义疑问 You know…, don't you?

zh: 你这周六有安排吗？我们几个想去Piha走走，你要不要一起？
en: Have you got anything on this Saturday? A few of us are heading out to Piha for a walk if you're keen.
alt: Are you busy on Saturday? A few of us are going out to Piha for a walk, do you want to come?
point: “有安排吗”说 Have you got anything on?，不说 have arrangement

zh: 你知道我们能不能用KiwiSaver的钱付首付吗？我们打算明年买房。
en: Do you know if we can use our KiwiSaver for a house deposit? We're planning to buy next year.
alt: Is it possible to take money out of KiwiSaver for the deposit? We're hoping to buy a house next year.
point: 间接疑问 if we can… 用陈述语序；首付是 deposit

zh: 这笔转账怎么还没到？你确定账号没填错吧？
en: Why hasn't the transfer gone through yet? You did put the right account number in, didn't you?
alt: How come the transfer still hasn't arrived? Are you sure you used the right account number?
point: “还没到”用 hasn't … yet；“确定…吧”用 did…, didn't you?
